author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have successfully bioprinted human kidney and liver tissues aboard the International Space Station using microgravity to achieve precise, even cell distribution. This milestone advances the potential for scalable, multi-tissue biomanufacturing that could revolutionize regenerative medicine and space healthcare.

Source Article: https://interestingengineering.com/space/first-kidney-liver-tissue-printed-in-space
